name: Econt
description: Econt Express delivery for shops in Bulgaria: live prices from Econt's API to an address or to an Econt office, office choice at checkout, and the chosen office on the order. Works with Econt's demo service until production credentials are entered.

settings.label: Environment
settings.help: Demo uses https://demo.econt.com/ee/services/ with Econt's public demo account; production uses https://ee.econt.com/services/ with your e-Econt account.

settings.label: Username
settings.help: Your e-Econt user for the environment above.

settings.label: Password
settings.help: Stored encrypted and never shown again.

settings.label: Sender name
settings.help: The shop or company that sends the parcels.

settings.label: Sending office code
settings.help: When you hand parcels in at an Econt office. Empty: they are picked up from the address below.

author: PN Scripts
